articles.title: The only way to go is down
articles.summary: Americans spend more than 13 hours a day consuming media, but only 25 hours a week receive their full attention. As media consumption grows, focused attention is shrinking. Social media and in-person entertainment are gaining a larger share of that attention. These channels have something in common. They encourage shared interests and community connection rather than passive consumption. The trend points to a growing divide between content that fills people's time and experiences that earn their attention.

articles.title: The Death of Owned Marketing
articles.summary: AI agents are changing how buyers discover and evaluate brands. Brand perception increasingly forms through third-party sources like customer reviews and online communities rather than company websites. Positioning needs to stay consistent across these sources, while original research should offer unique insights that earn independent citations. Brands should also test how AI tools recommend their products. As agents take on more of the buying process, pricing and checkout need to be accessible without human navigation.

articles.title: 6 tips on creator marketing
articles.summary: Gamma's creator marketing drove 32% of signups as the company scaled to $100M ARR. Its growth lead recommends measuring results across creator cohorts since individual post performance is highly unpredictable. Allocate 70% of budget to lower-cost creators and use platform-specific agencies. Track attribution through onboarding surveys rather than links. Refresh creative to prevent audience fatigue and combine professional creators and existing customers to balance reach.

articles.title: Show Online What Shoppers Can't Touch
articles.summary: Product images can recreate the in-store experience by showing shoppers textures and details they cannot experience online. Backdrop and Fireclay Tile use close-up photography and directional lighting to highlight surface details that flat color swatches miss. Lush Cosmetics shows bath bombs dissolving in water and scrubs spread out to demonstrate their consistency. Feature texture and product details early in the gallery, then use in-action images to show how products look and behave when used.

articles.title: How to take your best hook to another country
articles.summary: Subtitled hooks rarely travel, since they run on local jokes and references that translation strips out. Expansion works best one country at a time, starting where the app already ranks without any content. Some hooks only need a local store or city swapped in, while an in-joke that lands in one language needs a full rewrite. Local creators then film in their own dialect, with the app kept out of the first 2 seconds of the video.

articles.title: Turn 1-Hour Into 64 Pieces of Content, with Hiten Shah (Webinar)
articles.summary: Will Nelson's system connects listening, creation, and measurement to turn customer knowledge into content. In this webinar, he will walk through how to turn customer conversations and market signals into relevant ideas backed by real evidence. The webinar will take place on November 19 at 10 AM PT.

articles.title: How to Build an AI Customer Research Agent in Claude Code (59 minute video)
articles.summary: This podcast episode explains how to build an AI customer research agent in Claude Code to uncover why people abandon sign-up or cancel. The agent emails customers at key drop-off points using customer data from a CSV and custom instructions. It asks one question at a time, then categorizes replies and connects feedback to purchase behavior. In one example, Ancestry found that shipping concerns were a bigger conversion barrier than subscription fees. An LLM judge checks that replies are grounded in company documentation before sending.

articles.title: The Dutch Broadcaster That Stopped Tracking Its Viewers and Made More Money
articles.summary: Personalization doesn't always improve ad performance, and third-party tracking may add less value than the industry claims. Dutch broadcaster NPO eliminated third-party cookies and sold ads based on content and context instead, increasing ad revenue by 61%. Research found tracking added only 4% to publisher revenue. A travel site experiment found generic brand ads outperformed retargeting ads featuring hotels shoppers had viewed. Personalized ads performed better after shoppers visited a review site and narrowed their choices.

articles.title: How I Built an AI Marketing Team With Grok Bot Without Writing Code
articles.summary: A solo founder uses specialized AI bots to run marketing tasks on a schedule. Each bot has one defined role and follows a shared rules file with factual checks and clear limits. The marketing bot drafts content but requires human approval before anything is published. A weekly report adds lessons and updates instructions so future jobs improve. Batching content into a 21-day calendar reduces daily planning, while a separate bot checks actual outputs and flags stalled work.

articles.title: ChatGPT's new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
articles.summary: ChatGPT Wallet lets select US Pro subscribers aged 18+ use AI agents to shop and complete purchases.

articles.title: AI Chatbots Won't Stop Recommending Scam Websites to People Trying to Shop
articles.summary: A study of ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity found that all 3 recommend scam websites when users ask where to buy products or find regional stores.

articles.title: Viewers still struggling to find what to watch
articles.summary: Friends, trailers, and AI tools now do more to steer viewers to new shows than streaming algorithms do.
